Era: Mamluk Rule; Rulers: Mamluk Sultanate; Period: 1291 - 1517
Era: Ottoman Rule; Rulers: Ottoman Empire; Period: 1517 - 1917

Era: Modern Period; Rulers: Israel (since 1948), Palestinian territories (West Bank, Gaza); Period: 1948 - Present
Event: Muslims Capture Palestine; Year: 636 CE; Conqueror (Muslim Ruler): Caliph Umar ibn Khattab (Rashidun Caliphate); Opponent (Losing Side): Byzantine Empire (Emperor Heraclius)
Event: Muslims Lose Palestine (Crusades); Year: 1099 CE; Conqueror (Muslim Ruler): Crusaders; Opponent (Losing Side): Fatimid Caliphate
Event: Muslims Recapture Palestine; Year: 1187 CE; Conqueror (Muslim Ruler): Salahuddin Ayyubi (Ayyubid Sultanate); Opponent (Losing Side): Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem
Event: Muslims Lose Palestine (Ottoman Collapse & British Rule); Year: 1917 CE; Conqueror (Muslim Ruler): British Empire; Opponent (Losing Side): Ottoman Empire (Sultan Mehmed VI)
Event: Roman Expulsion; Period: 70 CE; Cause: Jewish Revolt vs. Rome; Impact: Mass exile of Jews
Event: Jewish Return (Aliyah); Period: 1882- 1948; Cause: Pogroms, Zionism, Holocaust; Impact: Jewish population increase, tensions rise
Event: Post-1948 Migration; Period: 1948+; Cause: Israel's creation, global factors; Impact: Mass migration from Europe, Arab lands
Event: Soviet Aliyah; Period: 1990s; Cause: USSR collapse, Zionism; Impact: Large wave from Russia & Eastern Europe
Event: Balfour Declaration; Year: 1917; Details: British Foreign Secretary Arthur Balfour wrote to Lord Rothschild, supporting a Jewish homeland in Palestine.
Event: San Remo Conference; Year: 1920; Details: Confirmed British Mandate over Palestine, giving Britain full administrative control.
Event: Demographics in 1947; Year: 1947; Details: Jews: ~33%, Arabs: ~67%.
Event: UN Partition Plan; Year: 1947; Details: Proposed separate states: Jews got 55%, Arabs got 42%, UN controlled 3% (Jerusalem). Accepted by Zionists, rejected by Arabs.
Event: End of British Rule; Year: 1948; Details: British Mandate ended.
Event: 1948 War (Arab- Israeli War); Year: 1948- 1949; Details: Israel vs. Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Lebanon, Iraq. Arabs lost; Israel expanded its territory. Led to Nakba (700,000 Palestinian refugees).
Event: Six-Day War; Year: 1967; Details: Israel fought Egypt, Syria, Jordan, Palestinians (Israel Won)
Event: UN Resolution 242; Year: 1967; Details: Called for Israel's withdrawal from occupied territories and recognition of all states' sovereignty.
Event: Yom Kippur War; Year: 1973; Details: Egypt & Syria attacked Israel. (Israel won)
Event: Camp David Accords; Year: 1978; Details: Peace treaty between Egypt (Anwar Sadat) and Israel (Menachem Begin), brokered by U.S. President Jimmy Carter. Israel withdraw from Sinai Penninsula.
Event: First Intifada; Year: 1987- 1993; Details: Armed uprising by Palestinians against Israeli rule in Gaza & West Bank.
Event: Oslo Accords I; Year: 1993; Details: Secret talks between Israel and PLO (Yasser Arafat), led to Palestinian self-rule in parts of the West Bank & Gaza.
Event: Second Intifada; Year: 2000- 2005; Details: Armed uprising triggered by tensions in Al-Aqsa Mosque.
Event: Arab Peace Initiative; Year: 2002; Details: Proposed full Arab-Israeli peace based on the two-state solution, with Israel withdrawing from occupied territories.

Event: Deal of the Century; Year: 2020; Details: U.S. plan by Jared Kushner (Trump's son-in-law). Key Points: No return of Palestinian refugees, annexation of most of the Golan Heights and West Bank, Jerusalem remains under Israeli control. Widely rejected by Palestinians.
Event: Hamas Formed; Year: 1987; Details: Founded by Sheikh Ahmed Yassin during the First Intifada.
Event: Palestinian Authority (PA) Formed; Year: 1994; Details: Established after the Oslo Accords to govern Palestinian territories. Founded by Yasser Arafat.
Event: Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) Formed; Year: 1964; Details: Represented Palestinians internationally. Founded by Ahmad Shukeiri.
Event: Israeli Settlements; Year: Ongoing; Details: Gaza Settlements: Existed until 2005 withdrawal. West Bank Settlements: Still present. Total Settlers: ~700,000.
Event: Proposed Solutions; Year: Ongoing; Details: Two-State Solution: Separate Israeli and Palestinian states. One-State Solution: Unified state. Status Quo: No clear resolution.
Event: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Turkey Stance; Year: Ongoing; Details: Support Palestinian statehood, call for ceasefire, condemn Israeli actions.
Event: Hamas Attack on Israel; Date: October 7,2023; Details: Hamas launched a large-scale attack on Israel.
Event: ICJ Case by South Africa; Date: Dec 2023; Details: South Africa accused Israel of genocide at the International Court of Justice (ICJ).
Event: ICJ Order on Palestine; Date: Jan 26,2024; Details: ICJ ordered Israel to take measures to prevent genocide but stopped short of calling for a full ceasefire.

Event: Ceasefire Agreement; Date: January 19,2025; Details: Ceasefire agreed after months of international pressure. Three Stages of Ceasefire: 1. Hostage Exchange 2. Complete Withdrawal of Forces. Increase in Humanitarian Aid. 3. Permanent Ceasefire and Rebuilding
Event: Trump's Plan (Riviera of the Middle East); Date: February 4,2025; Details: Resettle 2 million Palestinians out from Gaza in neighboring Muslim Countries.

Event: Arab League's Plan (Summit in Cairo); Date: March 4,2025; Details: 53 Billion Dollars for reconstruction.; Gaza to be ruled by Palestinians technocrats temporarily and later by PA; Rejected Trump's Plan for being against I.Law

Event: Israel Broke Ceasefire (Operation Might and Sword); Date: March 18,2025; Details: Israel says Hamas is not releasing hostages as agreed. In reality, Israel didn't even give a written guarantee to ceasefire.
Total Casualties (as of July 18 2025 by UN) - Palestinians: 58,000+ killed (80% civilians,33% children),139,000+ injured. Israelis: 1,900+ killed,5,000+ injured.
Generation: 1st Gen; Key Features: Stones, sticks, hand-to-hand combat; Example: Tribal Wars of Prehistoric Era
Generation: 2nd Gen; Key Features: Bows, arrows, swords; Example: Wars of Early Islam
Generation: 3rd Gen; Key Features: Guns, explosives; Example: East India Company Wars
Generation: 4th Gen; Key Features: Missiles, modern military tech; Example: Indo-Pak Wars
Generation: 5th Gen; Key Features: Cyber warfare, propaganda, media influence; Example: All Modern Wars Today
Event: Nadir Shah vs. India; Year: 1739; Details: Nadir Shah of Persia defeated the Mughal Emperor Muhammad Shah and sacked Delhi.
Event: Ruler of Delhi (1739); Year: 1739; Details: Mughal Emperor Muhammad Shah lost to Nadir Shah.
Event: Abdali vs. Marathas (Third Battle of Panipat); Year: 1761; Details: Ahmad Shah Abdali (Durrani Empire) defeated the Marathas.
Event: Anglo-Afghan War (First); Year: 1838- 1842; Details: Afghans won, defeating the British.
Event: Anglo-Afghan War (Second); Year: 1878- 1880; Details: Stalemate; Britain gained some areas, including Quetta.
Event: Anglo-Afghan War (Third); Year: 1919; Details: Afghanistan gained independence from British influence.
Event: Durand Line Agreement; Year: 1893; Details: Established the border between British India and Afghanistan.
Event: Daud Khan's Rule; Year: 1973- 1978; Details: Overthrew the Afghan monarchy and established a republic.
Event: Communist Rule & Saur Revolution; Year: 1978; Details: Communist coup led by the People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan (PDPA).
Event: Nur Muhammad Taraki vs. Hafizullah Amin; Year: 1979; Details: Power struggle; Amin assassinated Taraki and took control.
Event: Babrak Karmal Takes Power; Year: 1979; Details: Installed as Soviet-backed Afghan leader after Amin's assassination.
Event: Gorbachev's Reforms Begin; Year: 1985; Details: Mikhail Gorbachev sought Soviet withdrawal from Afghanistan.
Event: Geneva Agreement; Year: 1988; Details: Soviets agreed to withdraw from Afghanistan.
Event: Fall of the USSR; Year: 1991; Details: Broke into 15 independent countries.
Event: Advent of Taliban; Description: Rise of the Taliban in Afghanistan, later influencing Pakistan; Year: 1990s; Location: Afghanistan, Pakistan
Event: Northern Alliance Formation; Description: Anti-Taliban coalition led by Ahmad Shah Massoud; Year: 1992; Location: Afghanistan
Event: Tehreek-e-Nifaz-e- Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM) Formation; Description: Led by Sufi Muhammad, aimed to implement Shariah in Malakand; Year: 1992; Location: Pakistan (Malakand)
Event: Taliban Takeover of Afghanistan; Description: Taliban captured Kabul and established rule under Mullah Omar; Year: 1996; Location: Afghanistan
Event: Operation Enduring Freedom; Description: US-led invasion of Afghanistan after 9/11; Year: 7 October 2001; Location: Afghanistan
Event: Operation Iraqi Freedom; Description: US-led invasion of Iraq to remove Saddam Hussein; Year: 2003; Location: Iraq
Event: TSNM Rule in Swat; Description: TNSM took control in Swat (By Sufi Muhammad's Son in law Mullah Fazalullah), enforcing strict Islamic laws; Year: 2007-2008; Location: Pakistan (Swat)
Event: Operation Rah-e-Raast; Description: Military operation against militants in Swat; Year: 2009; Location: Pakistan (Swat)
Event: Operation Rah-e-Nijat; Description: Offensive against Taliban in South Waziristan; Year: 2009; Location: Pakistan (South Waziristan)
Event: Operation Zarb-e-Azb; Description: Launched after the rise in terrorism to eliminate TTP strongholds; Year: 15 June 2014; Location: Pakistan (North Waziristan)
Event: APS Peshawar Attack; Description: TTP terrorists killed 149 people, including 132 schoolchildren; Year: 16 December 2014; Location: Pakistan (Peshawar)
Event: National Action Plan (NAP); Description: 20-point strategy to counter terrorism after APS attack; Year: 24 December 2014; Location: Pakistan (Nationwide)
Event: Operation Radd-ul- Fasaad; Description: Nationwide operation to eliminate terrorist sleeper cells; Year: 2017; Location: Pakistan (Nationwide)
Event: Salala Check Post Attack; Description: NATO airstrike killed 24 Pakistani soldiers; Year: 2011; Location: Pakistan (Mohmand Agency)
Event: Raymond Davis Incident; Description: CIA contractor killed two Pakistanis in Lahore; Year: 2011; Location: Pakistan (Lahore)
Event: Operation Neptune Spear; Description: US Navy SEALs raid to kill Osama bin Laden; Year: 2011; Location: Pakistan (Abbottabad)
Event: Quadrilateral Coordination Group (QCG) Formation; Description: Pakistan, Afghanistan, China, USA peace talks group; Year: 11 January 2016; Location: Headquarters: Islamabad, Pakistan
Event: Fall of Kabul to Taliban; Description: Taliban captured Kabul, ending US- backed Afghan government under Hibatullah Akhundzada; Year: 15 August 2021; Location: Afghanistan
Event: Formation of Anglo-Persian Oil Company; Year: 1909; Details: British established APOC to exploit Iran's oil reserves.
Event: Saudi Aramco Formation; Year: 1933; Details: Joint Saudi-American oil company.
Event: Nationalization of Iranian Oil Industry; Year: 1951; Details: Prime Minister Mohammad Mossadegh nationalized Iranian oil, leading to British and American opposition.
Event: Mohammad Mossadegh Removed (CIA Coup - Operation Ajax); Year: 1953; Details: U.S. and UK orchestrated a coup, restoring Reza Shah Pahlavi to power.
Event: Reza Shah Pahlavi's Rule; Year: 1925- 1979; Details: Pro-Western Iranian ruler until the 1979 Islamic Revolution.
Event: Ayatollah Khomeini Came to Power; Year: 1979; Details: Led the Iranian Revolution, establishing the Islamic Republic.
Event: Iran vs. Saudi Arabia Rivalry; Year: Ongoing; Details: Rooted in Sunni-Shia tensions and Arab-Persian geopolitical rivalry. Proxy conflicts in Yemen, Syria, Lebanon, and Iraq.
Organization: Al-Qaeda; Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 1988; Founder(s): Osama bin Laden, Ayman Al Zahrawi; Region of Operation: Global (Middle East, South Asia, Africa)
Organization: Taliban; Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 1994; Founder(s): Mullah Mohammad Omar; Region of Operation: Afghanistan, Pakistan
Organization: Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP); Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 2007; Founder(s): Baitullah Mehsud; Region of Operation: Pakistan, Afghanistan
Organization: Islamic State (ISIS/ISIL/Daesh); Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 2014; Founder(s): Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi; Region of Operation: Middle East, South Asia, Africa
Organization: Islamic State - Khorasan Province (IS-K); Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 2015; Founder(s): Hafiz Saeed Khan; Region of Operation: Afghanistan, Pakistan
Organization: Haqqani Network; Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 1980s; Founder(s): Jalaluddin Haqqani; Region of Operation: Afghanistan, Pakistan
Organization: Boko Haram; Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 2002; Region of Operation: Nigeria, West Africa
Organization: Al-Shabaab; Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 2006; Region of Operation: Somalia, East Africa
Organization: Hizbul Mujahideen; Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 1989; Region of Operation: Kashmir (India, Pakistan)
Organization: Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan (IMU); Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 1998; Region of Operation: Central Asia, Afghanistan, Pakistan
Organization: East Turkestan Islamic Movement (ETIM); Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 1998; Region of Operation: Xinjiang, China
Organization: Al-Qaeda in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS); Formation Year (Widely Accepted): 2014; Region of Operation: South Asia (India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Myanmar)

Ayman al-Zawahiri - July 31,2022

Parties Involved: U.S. (CIA) & UK vs. Iranian PM Mossadegh; Causes: Mossadegh nationalized Iran's oil, Western economic interests; Key Events: CIA-led coup (Operation Ajax) overthrows Mossadegh; Outcome/Impact: U.S. installs pro-West Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi

Parties Involved: Iranian Revolution (Khomeini-led forces) vs. U.S.- backed Shah; Causes: Anti-Shah protests, Islamic movement, U.S. influence in Iran; Key Events: Shah overthrown, Ayatollah Khomeini establishes Islamic Republic; Outcome/Impact: U.S.-Iran ties severed, start of hostile relations

Year(s): 1979- 1981; Parties Involved: Iran vs. U.S.; Causes: Anger over U.S. sheltering the Shah; Key Events: Iranian Hostage Crisis - U.S. Embassy in Tehran seized,52 Americans held; Outcome/Impact: U.S. imposes sanctions; hostages released in 1981

Year(s): 1980- 1988; Parties Involved: Iran vs. Iraq (U.S. indirectly backs Iraq); Causes: Saddam Hussein invades Iran, U.S. sees Iran as a threat; Key Events: U.S. provides weapons to Iraq; Outcome/Impact: Devastating war, U.S.- Iran relations worsen

Year(s): 2002- 2015; Parties Involved: U.S. vs. Iran; Causes: U.S. accuses Iran of secretly developing nuclear weapons; Key Events: U.S. pushes sanctions, Iran Nuclear Deal (JCPOA) signed in 2015; Outcome/Impact: Iran agrees to limit nuclear program in exchange for sanctions relief

Year(s): 2018- 2020; Parties Involved: Trump Admin vs. Iran; Causes: Trump calls JCPOA counter- productive for USA; Key Events: U.S. withdraws from JCPOA (2018), reimposes sanctions; Soleimani assassinated (2020); Outcome/Impact: Iran retaliates, tensions peak but no full-scale war

Event: Iran-Iraq War; Year(s): 1980- 1988; Parties Involved: Iraq (Saddam) vs. Iran (Khomeini); Causes: Border disputes, Sunni-Shia rivalry; Key Events: Chemical weapons use, trench warfare; Outcome/Impact: Stalemate, heavy casualties

Event: Gulf War; Year(s): 1990- 1991; Parties Involved: Iraq vs. U.S.-led coalition; Causes: Saddam's invasion of Kuwait (1990); Key Events: Operation Desert Storm (1991), sanctions; Outcome/Impact: Iraq expelled, economic decline

Event: 2003 Iraq Invasion; Year(s): 2003- Present; Parties Involved: U.S., UK vs. Saddam Hussein's govt.; Causes: Alleged WMDs; Key Events: Saddam overthrown, sectarian violence; Outcome/Impact: Long-term instability, rise of ISIS

Event: US left Iraq; Year(s): 2011; Parties Involved: USA, Iraqi Forces; Causes: U.S. war fatigue, pressure to end occupation; Key Events: U.S. hands over security to Iraqi forces; Outcome/Impact: U.S. officially withdraws from Iraq (December 2011)
Parties Involved: ISIS vs. Iraq, Syria; Causes: Power vacuum post- 2003, sectarian divide; Key Events: ISIS captures major cities; Outcome/Impact: Declares caliphate

Year(s): 2015- 2017; Parties Involved: ISIS vs. Global Coalition (U.S., Iraq, Kurds, Russia, Iran); Causes: Global response to ISIS terror attacks; Key Events: ISIS started to lose Control; Outcome/Impact: ISIS loses most territory

Year(s): 2018- Present; Parties Involved: ISIS remnants vs. Security forces; Causes: Underground cells, lone-wolf attacks; Key Events: Leader Baghdadi killed in 2019; Outcome/Impact: Reduced presence, but insurgency remains

Country: Tunisia; Year(s): 2010- 2011; Parties Involved: Protesters vs. Gov. of Zine El Abidine Ben Ali; Causes: Corruption, unemployment, repression; Key Events: Self-immolation of Mohamed Bouazizi sparked protests; Ben Ali fled to Saudi Arabia; Outcome/Impact: Democratic transition, new constitution in 2014

Country: Egypt; Year(s): 2011,2013; Parties Involved: Protesters vs. Gov. of Hosni Mubarak, later vs. Morsi's govt.; Causes: Police brutality, economic issues; Key Events: Mubarak ousted in 2011; Morsi elected but removed by military in 2013; Outcome/Impact: Abdel Fattah el-Sisi became president (2014); increased authoritarianism

Country: Libya; Year(s): 2011- Present; Parties Involved: Rebels (NATO- backed) vs. Gaddafi's regime; Causes: Gaddafi's dictatorship, human rights abuses; Key Events: NATO airstrikes, Gaddafi killed; Outcome/Impact: Ongoing civil war, divided government

Country: Syria; Year(s): 2011- 2024; Parties Involved: Gov. of Bashar al- Assad vs. rebels, ISIS, foreign forces; Causes: Repression, economic crisis, Sectarian Factor (Population mostly Sunni, Bashr Al Assad is Shia); Key Events: Assad's crackdown led to full-scale war, foreign interventions; Outcome/Impact: Ongoing war, massive displacement

Country: Bahrain; Year(s): 2011; Parties Involved: Protesters (Shia- led) vs. Sunni monarchy; Causes: Sectarian tensions (population Shia mostly), lack of political rights; Key Events: Saudi military intervened to suppress protests; Outcome/Impact: Crackdown on dissent, monarchy remains in power

Country: Yemen; Year(s): 2011- Present; Parties Involved: Protesters vs. Ali Abdullah Saleh, later Houthi rebels vs. Saudi- backed government; Causes: Corruption, economic crisis; Key Events: Saleh resigned in 2012, but conflict escalated into war in 2014; Outcome/Impact: Ongoing civil war, humanitarian crisis
Parties Involved: Assad's govt. vs. Protesters; Causes: Arab Spring, repression; Key Events: Security forces fired on protesters; Outcome/Impact: Protests turned into armed rebellion

Year(s): 2012- 2013; Parties Involved: Syrian Army vs. FSA (Free Syrian Army); Causes: Continued government crackdowns; Key Events: Mass defections from Syrian military; Outcome/Impact: War expands, foreign involvement starts

Year(s): 2014- 2015; Parties Involved: ISIS vs. Syrian govt., Kurds, U.S.- led coalition; Causes: Power vacuum, sectarianism; Key Events: ISIS starts capturing important cities, U.S. starts airstrikes; Outcome/Impact: ISIS declared caliphate, Kurds gain influence

Year(s): 2016- 2019; Parties Involved: Syrian govt. (Russia, Iran- backed) vs. rebels; Causes: Russia intervenes; Key Events: Assad Forces starts recapturing, ISIS loses territory; Outcome/Impact: Assad regains control of most areas

Parties Involved: HTS (Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham) vs. Syrian Govt.; Causes: Rebel resurgence, internal instability; Key Events: Damascus falls (December 8), Assad flees to Russia (December 8,2004); Outcome/Impact: HTS claims control over Damascus

Period: July 13- 16,2025; Event: Druze-Bedouin clashes escalate; Location: Suwayda Province (Southern Syria); Reason: Abduction sparked sectarian violence among Druze & Bedouin tribes; Israel's Action: Airstrikes on Syrian Ministry of Defence Headquarters (16 July,2005)
Period: July 17,2025; Event: Ceasefire between Druze, Syria and Israel; Reason: Mediated by USA and Turkey
Parties Involved: Protesters vs. Ali Abdullah Saleh's govt.; Causes: Corruption, poverty; Key Events: Saleh forced to resign; Outcome/Impact: Power transferred to Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi
Parties Involved: Houthi rebels vs. Hadi's govt.; Causes: Houthi grievances, weak govt.; Key Events: Houthis capture Sanaa (Capital of Yemen); Outcome/Impact: Hadi flees, Saudi intervention starts

Year(s): 2015- 2018; Parties Involved: Saudi-led coalition vs. Houthis; Causes: Proxy war (Saudi vs. Iran); Key Events: Airstrikes, ground battles, famine worsens; Outcome/Impact: 150,000+ killed (As per UN), humanitarian crisis (227K+ killed due to famine)
Year(s): 2019- Present; Parties Involved: Houthis vs. Saudi- backed forces; Causes: Failed peace talks; Key Events: Sporadic ceasefires; Outcome/Impact: No resolution, worsening conditions
Conflict Name - Iran-Israel War (aka "12-Day War")
Start Date - June 13,2025 - Israel launched Operation Rising Lion, targeting nuclear & military sites
End Date - June 24,2025 - Ceasefire brokered by Donald Trump
Operation Names - Israel: Rising Lion -U.S.: Midnight Hammer on June 22
Targeted Sites - Iran's nuclear facilities [Natanz (most important), Fordow, Isfahan], IRGC/military leadership, Evin Prison
Iranian Retaliation - >550 ballistic missiles,>1,000 drones launched at Israel; missiles also targeted Al-Udeid, Qatar (June 23,2025)
U.S. Involvement - B-2 bombers and Tomahawks struck Iran's nuclear sites on June 22 under Trump's order
Casualties - Iran: ~1,000+ killed (Including 16 scientists) Israel: ~28-29 killed
Significant Incidents - 1. Evin Prison (Iran) bombing,2. ~80 dead - Soroka Hospital (Israel)
